actual_first_batch_intents.applicability_hypothesis: Financing and credit-facility disclosures available by 2025-05-30 may identify obligations affecting turnaround funding; their presence and economic adequacy require execution evidence.
actual_first_batch_intents.residual_need: As disclosed by 2025-05-30, establish unrestricted cash, operating cash burn, committed capital spending and covenant headroom, then assess whether these resources and constraints permit the turnaround milestones.
actual_first_batch_intents.selection_reason: Assess disclosed debt maturities and potential equity issuance terms for their effect on dilution and funding continuity.
